title: Cascade Ortho Rider Waiting Period Schedule
content:
For the Orthodontic Benefit Riders, the schedule below gives the waiting periods in calendar months from the rider effective date before banding is covered, together with the terms for prior orthodontic coverage. The event compared with the end of the waiting period is the banding date on every rider.

| Rider | Individual market, patient under 19 at banding | Individual market, patient 19 or over at banding | Group late entrant | Credit for prior orthodontic coverage | Longest gap after prior coverage ended (calendar days before the rider effective date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | 12 | 0 | 12 | none | 63 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | 12 | 0 | 12 | month for month | 63 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | 12 | 0 | 12 | month for month | 63 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | 12 | 24 | 12 | none | 63 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | 12 | 24 | 12 | month for month | 63 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | 12 | 24 | 12 | month for month | 63 |

### Column notes

- **Adult column:** 0 where adults are not eligible (the Child riders).
- **Group late entrant:** applies to a group rider of a late entrant. Group riders elected at open enrollment, as a new hire or by special enrollment have no waiting period.
- **Month-for-month credit:** each documented month of prior orthodontic coverage shortens the waiting period by one month. With "none", prior coverage gives no credit.
- **Gap:** prior orthodontic coverage earns credit only if it ended no more than 63 calendar days before the rider effective date.

*Hypothetical reading:* on a rider with month-for-month credit, a patient with 4 documented months of prior orthodontic coverage that ended 40 days before the rider effective date has those 4 months recorded. The same coverage ending 70 days before would earn no credit.
